local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local noclip = false

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
		noclip = not noclip
		print("Noclip:", noclip and "ON" or "OFF")
	end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if not player.Character then return end

	for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = not noclip
		end
	end
end)

    local function set(v, updateBox)
        v = tonumber(v)
        if not v then v = current end
        v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
        current = v
        local t = (max == min) and 0 or (v - min) / (max - min)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(t, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(t, 0, 0.5, 0)
        if updateBox ~= false then box.Text = string.format("%.2f", v) end
        local ok, err = pcall(callback, v)
        if not ok then warn("[Boombox] slider callback:", err) end
    end

    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local function update(i)
                local rel = (i.Position.X - track_.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track_.AbsoluteSize.X)
                rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
                set(min + rel * (max - min), true)
            end
            activeDrag = update
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if enter then set(box.Text, true) end
    end)

    set(default, true)
    return { set = set, get = function() return current end, frame = row }
end

local function normalizeId(raw)
    raw = (raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if tonumber(raw) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. raw
    end
    if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then return raw end
    if raw:match("^https?://") then
        local id = raw:match("(%d+)")
        if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
    end
    return raw
end

local function ensureSound()
    if state.sound and state.sound.Parent then return state.sound end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BoomboxSound"
    s.Looped = state.looped
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Parent = SoundService
    state.sound = s
    return s
end

local function stopSound()
    if state.sound then
        state.sound:Stop()
        state.sound:Destroy()
        state.sound = nil
    end
    state.playing = false
end

local function playSound()
    if state.soundId == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a music id first.")
        return
    end
    stopSound()
    local s = ensureSound()
    s.SoundId = state.soundId
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Looped = state.looped
    local ok, err = pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    if not ok then
        setStatus("Playback failed.")
        return
    end
    state.playing = true
    setStatus("Playing.")
end

local function pauseSound()
    if state.sound and state.playing then
        state.sound:Pause()
        state.playing = false
        setStatus("Paused.")
    end
end

local function resumeSound()
    if state.sound and not state.playing then
        state.sound:Resume()
        state.playing = true
        setStatus("Resumed.")
    end
end

local tabs = {}

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()

        tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Btn})
    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
            local sel = (t == entry)
            t.page.Visible = sel
            tween(t.btn, {
                BackgroundColor3 = sel and Theme.Accent or Theme.Btn,
                BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0.15 or 0.55,
            }, 0.18)
            t.btn.TextColor3 = sel and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.Text
        end
    end)

    return entry
end

    makeSection(page, "Music ID")
    local idBox = makeInput(page, "e.g. 1837879082", "", function(text)

scripts.script:

-- Rooms: Revisited Parody — Cheat Menu (v15)
-- LocalScript → StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService     = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player    = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ============================================================
-- НАСТРОЙКИ
-- ============================================================
local CONFIG = {
	openKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,

	entities = {
		["A-60"]   = { color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40),   label = "A-60 — Multi Monster" },
		["A-60b"]  = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 20),   label = "A-60b — Multi Bounder" },
		["A-70"]   = { color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 60, 180),  label = "A-70 — Locker Mimic" },
		["A-90"]   = { color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 60),  label = "A-90 — Paralysis" },
		["A-90b"]  = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0),   label = "A-90b — Sensation" },
		["A-200"]  = { color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255), label = "A-200 — Happy Scribble" },
	},
	blacklist = {
		["A200Fakeout"]            = true,
		["fakesounda60"]           = true,
		["fakesounda200"]          = true,
		["FakeToolViewFlashlight"] = true,
	},

	spawnFolder = nil,
	duration    = 4.5,
	playSound   = true,
	soundId     = "rbxassetid://4550994248",
	volume      = 0.6,

	doorTargetName = "DoorSign",
	doorDotColor   = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
	doorDotSize    = 15,

	flySpeedMin  = 1, flySpeedMax  = 5,
	loopSpeedMin = 1, loopSpeedMax = 100,
	fovMin       = 30, fovMax      = 120,
}

local SETTINGS = {
	doorESP = true, notifications = true,
	fly = false, noclip = false,
	loopSpeed = false, instantPrompts = false, loopFOV = false,
	fullbright = false, nofog = false,
}

local VALUES = { flySpeed = 3, loopSpeed = 16, fov = 70 }

-- Forward declarations
local flyUpBtn, flyDownBtn
local noclipActive = false
local flyActive = false
local flyBV

local function getHumanoid()
	local char = player.Character
	return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

-- ============================================================
-- 1. DOT ESP (зелёная точка на дверях)
-- ============================================================
local dotESP = {}

local function getObjPos(obj)
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		return obj:GetPivot().Position
	elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		return obj.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function addDot(obj, color, size)
	if dotESP[obj] then return end
	local pos = getObjPos(obj)
	if not pos then return end

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "DotESP"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.MaxDistance = 9999
	gui.Adornee = obj
	gui.Parent = obj

	local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
	dot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = color
	dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	dot.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = dot

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = dot

	dotESP[obj] = gui

	obj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			if dotESP[obj] then
				dotESP[obj]:Destroy()
				dotESP[obj] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function removeDot(obj)
	if dotESP[obj] then
		dotESP[obj]:Destroy()
		dotESP[obj] = nil
	end
end

local function clearDoorDots()
	for obj, gui in pairs(dotESP) do
		if gui then gui:Destroy() end
		dotESP[obj] = nil
	end
end

local function scanDoorDots()
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj.Name == CONFIG.doorTargetName and (obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart")) then
			addDot(obj, CONFIG.doorDotColor, CONFIG.doorDotSize)
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================================
-- 2. УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ (V1 стиль, правый нижний угол)
-- ============================================================
local function showNotification(entityName)
	local cfg = CONFIG.entities[entityName]
	if not cfg then return end

	local screen = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RoomsNotifier")
	if not screen then
		screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		screen.Name = "RoomsNotifier"
		screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
		screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		screen.Parent = playerGui
	end

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Panel"
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 64)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -380, 1, 20)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Parent = screen

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = panel

	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Name = "Bar"
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, 0)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = cfg.color
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.Parent = panel
	local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
	barCorner.Parent = bar

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = cfg.label
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 17
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = panel

	local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	sub.Name = "Sub"
	sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
	sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 36)
	sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sub.Text = "Entity has spawned — hide!"
	sub.TextColor3 = cfg.color
	sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	sub.TextSize = 13
	sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	sub.Parent = panel

	if CONFIG.playSound then
		local sfx = Instance.new("Sound")
		sfx.SoundId = CONFIG.soundId
		sfx.Volume = CONFIG.volume
		sfx.Parent = panel
		sfx:Play()
	end

	local inTween = TweenService:Create(
		panel,
		TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Position = UDim2.new(1, -380, 1, -84) }
	)
	inTween:Play()

	task.delay(CONFIG.duration, function()
		local outTween = TweenService:Create(
			panel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(1, -380, 1, 20) }
		)
		outTween:Play()
		outTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			panel:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- 3. FULLBRIGHT / NOFOG
-- ============================================================
local lightOrig = {
	Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
	ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
	Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
	OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
	GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
	FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
	FogStart       = Lighting.FogStart,
}
local function setFullbright(on)
	if on then
		Lighting.Brightness = 3
		Lighting.ClockTime = 14
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	else
		Lighting.Brightness = lightOrig.Brightness
		Lighting.ClockTime = lightOrig.ClockTime
		Lighting.Ambient = lightOrig.Ambient
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = lightOrig.OutdoorAmbient
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = lightOrig.GlobalShadows
	end
end
local function setNoFog(on)
	if on then
		Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
		Lighting.FogStart = 100000
	else
		Lighting.FogEnd = lightOrig.FogEnd
		Lighting.FogStart = lightOrig.FogStart
	end
end

-- ============================================================
-- 4. FLY
-- ============================================================
local function startFly()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flyBV.Name = "FlyVelocity"
	flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	flyBV.Parent = hrp
	flyActive = true
end

local function stopFly()
	flyActive = false
	if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy() flyBV = nil end
end

local mobileUpHeld, mobileDownHeld = false, false

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not flyActive then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (hrp and hum) then return end
	if not flyBV or flyBV.Parent ~= hrp then startFly() end
	local move = hum.MoveDirection
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or mobileUpHeld then
		move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or mobileDownHeld then
		move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	flyBV.Velocity = move * (VALUES.flySpeed * 30)
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 5. NOCLIP
-- ============================================================
local function applyNoclip()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

local function applyClip()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = true
		end
	end
end

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if noclipActive then applyNoclip() end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	if flyActive then task.wait(0.3) startFly() end
	if noclipActive then task.wait(0.3) applyNoclip() end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 6. LOOP SPEED / LOOP FOV
-- ============================================================
local origFOV = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView or 70

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if SETTINGS.loopSpeed then
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = VALUES.loopSpeed end
	end
	if SETTINGS.loopFOV then
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then cam.FieldOfView = VALUES.fov end
	end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 7. INSTANT PROXIMITY PROMPTS
-- ============================================================
local function applyInstantPrompts()
	for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			if p:GetAttribute("origHold") == nil then
				p:SetAttribute("origHold", p.HoldDuration)
				p:SetAttribute("origDist", p.MaxActivationDistance)
			end
			p.HoldDuration = 0
			p.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(p.MaxActivationDistance, 20)
		end
	end
end

local function restorePrompts()
	for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p:GetAttribute("origHold") ~= nil then
			p.HoldDuration = p:GetAttribute("origHold")
			p.MaxActivationDistance = p:GetAttribute("origDist")
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================================
-- 8. ДЕТЕКТ СУЩНОСТЕЙ + УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ
-- ============================================================
local seen = {}
local watchRoot = CONFIG.spawnFolder or workspace

local function isFake(obj)
	if CONFIG.blacklist[obj.Name] then return true end
	if obj.Name:lower():find("fake") then return true end
	return false
end

local function checkInstance(obj)
	if SETTINGS.doorESP and obj.Name == CONFIG.doorTargetName
		and (obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart")) then
		addDot(obj, CONFIG.doorDotColor, CONFIG.doorDotSize)
	end

	if SETTINGS.instantPrompts and obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
		if obj:GetAttribute("origHold") == nil then
			obj:SetAttribute("origHold", obj.HoldDuration)
			obj:SetAttribute("origDist", obj.MaxActivationDistance)
		end
		obj.HoldDuration = 0
		obj.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(obj.MaxActivationDistance, 20)
	end

	local name = obj.Name
	if isFake(obj) then return end

	if CONFIG.entities[name] or (name:match("^A%-%d+") and obj:IsA("Model")) then
		if seen[obj] then return end
		seen[obj] = true

		if not CONFIG.entities[name] then
			CONFIG.entities[name] = {
				color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 30),
				label = name .. " — Unknown Entity",
			}
		end

		if SETTINGS.notifications then
			showNotification(name)
		end

		obj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if parent == nil then
				seen[obj] = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	checkInstance(obj)
end

watchRoot.DescendantAdded:Connect(checkInstance)

-- ============================================================
-- 9. МЕНЮ
-- ============================================================
local isMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled

local menuGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
menuGui.Name = "RoomsCheatMenu"
menuGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
menuGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
menuGui.Parent = playerGui

local menu = Instance.new("Frame")
menu.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 460)
menu.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -230)
menu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
menu.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
menu.BorderSizePixel = 0
menu.Visible = false
menu.Parent = menuGui
local menuCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
menuCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
menuCorner.Parent = menu
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
stroke.Thickness = 1
